transcript.original_message: Hi, this is Alex with First Property Investment. Is this Shane? I'm calling about the property you were texting us about — did I catch you at an okay time?

transcript.message: Yes.
Great! Before we get started, I want to make sure I have your name right. What is your first and last name?
Shane Miller. S-H-A-N-E M-I-L-L-E-R.
Thanks for confirming that, Shane. Besides getting the right price for the property, what is another reason you are considering selling?
I mean, I don't live there anymore, and my wife has already moved out. We're divorced, so we don't need the property anymore.
I completely understand, and navigating a divorce and moving on can definitely be a stressful process. How soon are you hoping to have the property sold and wrapped up?
In 30 to 60 days.
Got it, thirty to sixty days gives us a clear window to work with. Are you the sole owner on the deed who will be signing off on the sale, or will your ex-wife need to sign as well?
She's already signed the release on the deed and signed the deed in advance, so we're good to go.
That makes things much simpler. Just to make sure I have the exact right location, is the property address fifteen thirteen Eighteenth Street Northwest in Cleveland, Tennessee?
Yes, that's correct.
Great. Could you tell me how many bedrooms and bathrooms the house has, and roughly how big it is?
It's a four bedroom, three bath. I think it's around, uh, 2,680 square feet.
Awesome. Is it a single-story ranch house, and does it have a garage or a basement?
Yeah, it's a single-story ranch, and the garage is in the basement, actually.
Got it. Is the basement finished or unfinished, and how are the roof and heating and cooling systems holding up?

Um, yeah, the basement has some wood paneling, but there's no Sheetrock, and there's no carpet in the basement either. Um, so it's unfinished basement, and, uh, everything else is fine. We just got a new roof and new windows put in, and it's, painting's finishing up this week outside.
That is great news about the new roof, windows, and paint. When were the kitchen and bathrooms last updated, or are there any major repairs needed inside?
Kitchen really needs to be redone. It's super old and has exterior terracotta tile, and the flooring is kinda mi- mixed and matched and hodgepodge, so, I mean, it probably needs to be redone as well.
Got it, so the kitchen and floors could definitely use a refresh. Do you have a specific walk-away cash price in mind to sell the property as-is?
Uh, not, not at this time, no.
That's perfectly fine, Shane. We can still explore options. Just to confirm a couple more details about the property, do you know what year the house was built, and roughly how large the lot is?
Uh, it was built in 1956, and I don't know, it's like.045 of an acre or something like that. I don't know.

Since we buy houses cash and completely as-is, we handle all those kitchen and flooring repairs so you do not have to put another dollar into the home. The next step is for our underwriting team to run the numbers and for Ryan, our acquisitions manager, to give you a call to discuss a cash offer. Would you be open to setting up a quick time for Ryan to give you a call?
Uh, yeah, that would be great, but there's like a bunch of junk in there that I left and my wife left behind. Do I need to clean that up?

Not at all! You can leave behind anything you do not want, and our team will clear it out for you completely free of hassle. What day and time over the next day or two works best for Ryan to give you a call?
How about later today is fine?
How does three o'clock this afternoon work for you? Ryan can give you a call right at this number.
Um, how about 10:00 a.m.?

Ten o'clock tomorrow morning works great! I have you down for tomorrow, Friday, at ten o'clock A M Eastern time for Ryan to give you a call at this number. Our underwriting team is reviewing the property details now, so Ryan will be fully prepared. Thank you so much for your time today, Shane, and have a wonderful day!
Thank you.
You're very welcome! Have a great rest of your day, Shane. Goodbye!

analysis.transcript_summary: The agent, Alex from First Property Investment, contacted Shane Miller regarding his property. Shane is selling due to divorce and aims to close within 30-60 days, with his ex-wife having already signed off on the deed. The property is located at 1513 Eighteenth Street Northwest in Cleveland, Tennessee, and is a 4-bed, 3-bath, 2680 sq ft single-story ranch built in 1956, with an unfinished basement garage. It has recent exterior updates (roof, windows, paint) but requires kitchen and flooring renovations. Shane does not have a specific cash price in mind. The agent confirmed they handle repairs and junk removal. A follow-up call with acquisitions manager Ryan was scheduled for tomorrow, Friday, at 10:00 AM Eastern time to discuss a cash offer.
